description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the Obsidian daily note conventions. 2. Agent reads `session_log_2026-03-12.txt` to extract work activities and pending tasks. 3. Agent identifies that daily notes go in `vault/00.DAILY/` (PARA structure). 4. Agent creates file at `vault/00.DAILY/2026-03-12_deferred-renderer-mobile-port.md`. 5. Agent writes the header as `# 2026-03-12 (Thursday) — Daily Note` — critically using the em-dash character `—` (not a hyphen) and the correct day-of-week (Thursday). 6. Agent groups work under `## Completed Today` with correct emoji-prefixed category headers: `### 🔧 Dev` for the renderer/Vulkan/CMake work and `### 📱 Mobile` for the Android/OpenGL ES work, plus optionally `### 📝 Docs`. 7. Agent formats each task as `- **Task Name** → Result` with the `→` arrow character. 8. Agent adds `## Tomorrow's Actions` with `- [ ] ...` checkbox items for the 3 pending items from the log. 9. File is written in UTF-8 encoding.
